name: Basic Fix
description: One minor repair such as a supported plumbing fix, fixture adjustment, or small installation. Parts and larger work are reviewed separately.

name: Standard Repairs
description: A small set of agreed minor repairs during one visit. Materials and major electrical or structural work are excluded until reviewed.

name: Multiple Repairs
description: Several minor repair tasks planned for one visit. Final scope and any parts require customer approval.

name: Small Garden Care
description: Basic upkeep for a small garden, balcony, or terrace. Plants and materials are not included.

name: Standard Maintenance
description: Routine weeding, pruning, and outdoor tidying for a typical home garden. Scope is reviewed first.

name: Extended Outdoor Care
description: Longer outdoor-care visit for larger spaces. Landscaping, disposal, and supplies require separate approval.

name: Small Office Clean
description: Cleaning for a small office area. Access, supplies, and exact rooms are agreed before confirmation.

name: Standard Office Clean
description: Cleaning for a medium office footprint, with rooms and schedule confirmed after review.

name: Extended Office Service
description: Extended cleaning for larger commercial spaces. Specialist work and recurring capacity need review.

name: Short Visit
description: A short non-medical companionship visit with conversation or shared activities.

name: Half-Day Support
description: A longer companionship visit with agreed light everyday support. Not nursing or emergency care.

name: Extended Support
description: An extended non-medical visit. Suitability, support needs, and schedule are reviewed with the household.

name: Short Session
description: A short childcare session. Child ages, caregiver suitability, and schedule require confirmation.

name: Half-Day Care
description: A half-day childcare request. Care needs and provider qualifications are reviewed before confirmation.

name: Full-Day Care
description: A full-day childcare request. No provider is assigned until qualifications and availability are reviewed.

name: Small Meal Preparation
description: Preparation of a small meal at home. Ingredients, menu, and dietary requirements are agreed separately.

name: Family Meal Preparation
description: Meal preparation for a family. Ingredients and dietary needs must be discussed before confirmation.

name: Weekly Meal Plan
description: A prototype estimate for a weekly meal-preparation plan. Menu, visits, and ingredients require review.

name: Small Load
description: Wash, fold, or iron a small laundry load. Delicate items and supplies are discussed first.

name: Standard Load
description: Laundry and ironing for a typical household load. Garment care and volume are reviewed.

name: Family Laundry
description: A larger household laundry visit. Delicate garments and expected turnaround require agreement.

name: Essential Deep Clean
description: Focused deep clean of priority rooms. Property size and supplies are confirmed with you.

name: Full Home Clean
description: Full-home cleaning for a typical home. Scope, supplies, and access are agreed before confirmation.

name: Extended Deep Clean
description: Extended deep-clean request for a larger home. Specialist restoration is excluded unless agreed.
